brief: Three instrument cues in one brief. HARNESS is the kind, so courtyard.html is byte-identical to HEAD and `srcChanged:false` is EXPECTED — that is not a no-ship. (1) c280: census.mjs's CORE collapse check reads only the SUMMER scalars, so the winter block has no collapse guard and a build that breaks the town only in February diffs loudly and exits 0. CORE cannot be reused as-is (winter planted is 788 against summer's 6583); give the winter row its own floor, cut from its own baseline. (2) c284: scalars.structures SUMS heterogeneous registers, so a build-time CONSTANT dilutes the guard — #189's eaveLine (217 a sample) took it 4059 -> 6314 and 31% of it can now never move. Report the registers apart, or exclude the constant ones, and write in census.mjs's own comments which is which. (3) c289: 9 probes still throw `spawnSync git ENOBUFS` across 11 sites — courtyard.html passed Node's 1 MiB default maxBuffer at #181, so every `git show HEAD:courtyard.html` control without it has been dead since. #195 fixed 2. Fix the rest.
successLooksLike: probe-smoke.mjs's THROW count falls by the 9 ENOBUFS probes and the new number is quoted against #195's 361 instruments / 230 pass / 35 throw / 96 timeout. A deliberately winter-only breakage (revert #200's buildIceLap in a scratch tree) makes census.mjs exit non-zero where HEAD's census exits 0 on the same tree. census.mjs prints the constant share of `structures` beside the total.
avoid: Do not touch courtyard.html. Do not re-cut CORE's existing ladder string — EXTEND it by ADDING a row under it, or every stored baseline stops comparing. The 96 probe TIMEOUTS are explicitly out of scope; they need a budget this brief does not have, and half-diagnosing them is worse than leaving them named.
